name: Andrews University
intl_aid_notes: International scholarships up to ~50% of tuition for qualified students; Adventist denominational aid stacks on top. The flagship Adventist university in North America.
city_vibe: Small, quiet college town along the St. Joseph River in rural Michigan.
church_life: Adventist-majority campus; Sabbath observance is central, with multiple churches walkable from campus.
climate: Cold, snowy winters; humid summers. Real adjustment from Addis (which averages ~16°C year-round).
work_life_balance: Calm, observant Sabbath culture (Friday sundown to Saturday sundown is set aside).
education_quality: Long-standing nursing program with strong placement into the Adventist Health hospital network.
post_school: Reliable pipeline to AdventHealth, Loma Linda Health, and other Adventist hospital employers.

name: Loma Linda University
intl_aid_notes: Smaller institutional aid for intl undergrads than Andrews, but Adventist denominational scholarships, work-study, and Loma Linda Health employment pathways help cover gaps.
city_vibe: Health-focused small town in the Inland Empire of Southern California, surrounded by an Adventist health system.
church_life: Built around an Adventist health-and-faith mission; campus and town life revolve around the church and the hospital.
climate: Hot, dry summers; mild winters. Very different from Addis but easy on the body.
work_life_balance: Service-oriented culture; the university tagline is "to make man whole."
education_quality: Well-respected nursing school feeding directly into one of the largest Adventist hospital systems in the US.
post_school: Direct pipeline to Loma Linda University Health and other West Coast hospitals.

name: Eastern University
intl_aid_notes: Christ-centered program with merit aid for international students with strong academics; clinical partnerships with Philadelphia-area hospitals.
city_vibe: Leafy suburban campus 30 min from downtown Philadelphia — quiet, walkable, near a major US city.
church_life: Christian community focus runs through campus life; chapel and small groups are core, denominationally welcoming.
climate: Four real seasons; cold winters but not extreme.
work_life_balance: Service-minded, mission-oriented student body; manageable urban access.
education_quality: Solid regional nursing program with clinical rotations across the Philadelphia hospital system.
post_school: Philadelphia is one of the largest healthcare job markets in the US.

name: John Brown University
intl_aid_notes: Strong international student program; merit scholarships routinely cover a third to a half of tuition. JBU is unusually friendly to applicants from missionary or developing-world Christian families.
city_vibe: Small Christian college town in the Ozarks; safe, affordable, slow-paced.
church_life: Interdenominational chapel culture; large international and missionary-kid community on campus.
climate: Hot summers, mild winters; some snow.
work_life_balance: Tight-knit, supportive campus; lower cost of living than the coasts.
education_quality: Strong NCLEX pass rates and high job placement; CCNE-accredited.
post_school: Most graduates work in Arkansas, Oklahoma, Texas, or Missouri healthcare systems.

name: Slippery Rock University
intl_aid_notes: SRU offers an automatic international scholarship to admitted undergraduates (roughly $3,500/year off out-of-state tuition + a $1,500 admission award + a possible $500 boost for 3.5+ GPA). The top-end figures cited elsewhere require stacking external merit scholarships, which are not automatic. Verify the current breakdown at sru.edu/admissions/international.
city_vibe: Small public-university town in western Pennsylvania, ~1 hour north of Pittsburgh.
church_life: No religious affiliation, but a large Christian student body and active campus ministries (Cru, InterVarsity, others).
work_life_balance: Big-state-school feel at a small price; lots of student activities and intramurals.
education_quality: Public regional university with affordable tuition and CCNE-accredited nursing.
post_school: Strong placement into Pittsburgh-area hospitals (UPMC system).

name: East Tennessee State University
intl_aid_notes: Specific nursing scholarships for international students who achieve a 3.0+ GPA equivalent and hold an F-1 or J-1 visa.
city_vibe: Mid-sized college town in the Appalachian foothills; mountains, low cost of living, friendly southern hospitality.
church_life: Region is in the heart of the American Bible Belt; abundant church options and active Christian student groups on campus.
work_life_balance: Affordable, slower-paced; outdoor lifestyle.
education_quality: Public university with a well-regarded health-sciences focus.
post_school: Pipeline into Ballad Health and the broader southern Appalachian hospital network.

name: University of Illinois Chicago
intl_aid_notes: Dedicated scholarships for current intl UIC students in the BSN program; requires a 3.5 cumulative GPA. Apply first as a freshman and earn aid once enrolled.
city_vibe: Big urban research university in the middle of Chicago — diverse, busy, world-class healthcare scene.
church_life: No religious affiliation; Chicago has thousands of churches of every denomination, including a significant Ethiopian Orthodox community.
climate: Long, cold winters by Lake Michigan; mild summers.
work_life_balance: Urban, fast-paced, lots of clinical opportunity at the University of Illinois Hospital next door.
education_quality: Top-tier public nursing program; high research output and clinical exposure.
post_school: Direct pipeline to large Chicago hospital systems (UI Health, Rush, Northwestern, U Chicago Medicine).

name: Johns Hopkins University
bsn_program: No traditional BSN — Hopkins Nursing offers an MSN entry program for non-nurses (after a bachelor's). Listed here for the future-MSN path.
intl_aid_notes: Hopkins School of Nursing supports international applicants through scholarships and assistantships at the graduate level. The undergraduate university is need-AWARE for international applicants (not need-blind) — meaning ability to pay can influence admission — but Hopkins meets 100% of demonstrated need for international students it admits. Undergrad nursing is not a direct pathway here.
city_vibe: Historic Baltimore neighborhood; world-class hospital (Johns Hopkins Hospital) is a 10-minute shuttle away.
church_life: Diverse, with strong Christian, Catholic, and Orthodox communities in Baltimore.
climate: Mild compared with Chicago; four seasons.
work_life_balance: Intense academic culture; world-leading hospital nearby is the main draw.
education_quality: Top-ranked nursing school in the world by US News on most recent lists.
post_school: Direct pipeline to Johns Hopkins Hospital and similarly elite employers.

name: Harvard University
bsn_program: No nursing major — listed as a need-blind path. Undergrads who want to nurse pursue a related major (e.g., biology) and then a graduate nursing entry program (MEPN).
intl_aid_notes: Need-blind for international applicants and meets 100% of demonstrated need with grants (no loans). If admitted with full need, attendance is essentially free.
city_vibe: Iconic historic campus by Boston; one of the densest academic ecosystems in the world.
church_life: Active Christian fellowships (Harvard Christian Fellowship, Harvard Catholic Center, others).
work_life_balance: Demanding but supportive; tons of resources.
education_quality: Globally elite.
post_school: Open doors anywhere. Most aspiring nurses do a post-bac MEPN at a top nursing school.

name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bsn_program: No nursing major — need-blind path to a graduate nursing entry program afterwards.
intl_aid_notes: Need-blind for international students; meets full demonstrated need.
city_vibe: Engineering-first culture by the Charles River in Cambridge/Boston.
church_life: Active Christian and Muslim communities; multi-faith chapel.
work_life_balance: Intense; STEM-heavy.
education_quality: Globally elite.
post_school: Bridge to top graduate nursing or biomedical programs.

name: Yale University
bsn_program: Yale School of Nursing is graduate-entry (GEPN). Undergrads at Yale College can major in anything and apply later.
intl_aid_notes: Need-blind for international undergraduates; meets full need without loans. Yale School of Nursing (graduate) is one of the best in the country.
city_vibe: Historic Gothic campus in New Haven; small-city feel with major medical center attached.
church_life: Battell Chapel is the historic Christian center; many active groups.
work_life_balance: Residential-college system is famously supportive.
education_quality: Globally elite.
post_school: Open doors; Yale-New Haven Hospital next door.

name: Princeton University
intl_aid_notes: Need-blind for all applicants including international; replaces loans with grants entirely.
city_vibe: Quiet, leafy university town in central New Jersey; 1 hour to New York and Philadelphia.
church_life: Christian fellowships are large and active; Princeton Christian Fellowship, others.
work_life_balance: Supportive residential college system.
education_quality: Globally elite.
post_school: Graduate nursing pathway afterwards.

name: Amherst College
bsn_program: No nursing major — need-blind liberal-arts path; graduate nursing entry program after.
intl_aid_notes: Need-blind for international students; meets full demonstrated need.
city_vibe: Small New England town; part of the Five Colleges consortium.
church_life: Christian fellowships active across the consortium.
work_life_balance: Famously generous and supportive small college.
education_quality: Top liberal arts college.
post_school: Strong pre-health advising; bridge to top MEPN/MSN programs.

name: Bowdoin College
intl_aid_notes: Need-blind for international applicants as of 2022; meets full demonstrated need.
city_vibe: Coastal Maine, very small town.
church_life: Active Christian fellowships; small but tight community.
work_life_balance: Quiet, outdoor lifestyle.
education_quality: Top liberal arts college.
post_school: Bridge to graduate nursing.

name: Brown University
bsn_program: No nursing major — need-blind path (intl need-blind from class of 2029).
intl_aid_notes: Became need-blind for international applicants starting with the class of 2029 (entering fall 2025) and meets full need.
city_vibe: Open-curriculum culture in walkable Providence.
church_life: Strong Catholic and Christian student groups.
work_life_balance: Liberal, flexible academic culture.
education_quality: Ivy League.
post_school: Bridge to graduate nursing.

name: Dartmouth College
intl_aid_notes: Need-blind for international applicants since 2022; meets full demonstrated need with scholarships and on-campus work.
city_vibe: Small New England town in the Upper Valley.
church_life: Christian student groups active; small community.
work_life_balance: D-Plan rotational calendar; tight community.
education_quality: Ivy League.
post_school: Pipeline to Dartmouth-Hitchcock Medical Center for healthcare experience.

name: Grinnell College
bsn_program: No nursing major — need-blind liberal-arts path.
intl_aid_notes: Need-blind for international students; replaces loans with grants in financial-aid packages.
city_vibe: Small Iowa town; close-knit liberal arts experience.
church_life: Active Christian groups including InterVarsity.
work_life_balance: Quiet, focused, residential.
education_quality: Top liberal arts college.
post_school: Pre-health advising bridges to graduate nursing.

name: Liberty University
bsn_program: Traditional BSN on residential campus; large RN-to-BSN online program too.
intl_aid_notes: Liberty advertises one of the lower private-university sticker costs; merit aid available. Strong missionary-friendly admissions culture.
city_vibe: Foothills of the Blue Ridge Mountains in central Virginia.
church_life: Convocation services are the largest weekly Christian gathering in North America.
work_life_balance: Conservative campus culture; strict student handbook.
education_quality: Large evangelical university with growing health-sciences programs.
post_school: Pipeline into Virginia hospital systems.

name: Colorado Christian University
intl_aid_notes: Christ-centered nursing program with merit and need-based aid for international students.
city_vibe: Foothills of the Rockies near Denver.
church_life: Christian-mission university with weekly chapel and small groups.
work_life_balance: Outdoor lifestyle; close to mountains.
education_quality: Solid regional reputation with active clinical partners in Denver.
post_school: Denver-area hospital pipeline.

name: Pacific Union College
intl_aid_notes: Adventist denominational discounts; small-campus, mission-focused environment.
city_vibe: Tiny mountain-top campus in Napa Valley, California.
church_life: Adventist community is central to the experience.
work_life_balance: Quiet, observant; small campus.
education_quality: Long-running Adventist nursing program.
post_school: Adventist Health network; Bay Area hospital access.

name: University of San Francisco
bsn_program: BSN through the School of Nursing and Health Professions, CCNE-accredited
intl_aid_notes: Limited need-based aid for international students, but merit scholarships and Jesuit-affiliated awards are available; urban clinical sites in San Francisco are world-class.
city_vibe: Hilltop urban campus in central San Francisco — diverse, expensive, and beautiful.
church_life: Jesuit Catholic university with strong interfaith life and an Ignatian-spirituality center.
climate: Mild year-round; foggy summers, cool winters.
work_life_balance: Big-city access; significant cost of living.
education_quality: Well-regarded nursing program in a top healthcare city.
post_school: UCSF Health, Kaiser Permanente, and Sutter Health pipeline.

name: University of Pittsburgh
intl_aid_notes: Pitt Nursing accepts international applicants; merit scholarships available, need-based aid limited for non-citizens.
city_vibe: Energetic urban campus in Pittsburgh's Oakland neighborhood, adjacent to UPMC.
church_life: Diverse Christian student groups; large Catholic presence.
work_life_balance: Big-research-university energy.
education_quality: One of the most respected nursing schools in the US.
post_school: UPMC system pipeline (one of the largest hospital systems in the US).

name: University of Notre Dame
bsn_program: No direct-entry BSN at Notre Dame itself; pre-nursing students typically pair an undergraduate degree with a graduate nursing entry program after.
intl_aid_notes: Notre Dame became need-blind for international applicants in 2023 and meets 100% of demonstrated need with grants — no loans. One of the strongest reach options for Christian international students.
city_vibe: Iconic Catholic university in northern Indiana; close-knit residential campus.
church_life: Catholic identity is central; daily Mass and active interfaith life. Welcoming to all Christian denominations.
work_life_balance: Strong residential dorm system; supportive campus.
education_quality: Top-tier US university; pre-health advising is strong.
post_school: Pipeline into top graduate nursing programs.

name: Berea College
bsn_program: No direct BSN — pre-nursing track that pairs with neighboring nursing partner schools, or pathway to graduate nursing entry programs.
intl_aid_notes: Berea is TUITION-FREE for every admitted student, including international students. Students work ~10 hours/week on campus as part of the model. Acceptance is competitive (intl admit rate is very low) but financially it is unmatched. The trade-off: no direct BSN, so you'd graduate, take graduate nursing entry, and become a nurse via that route.
city_vibe: Small Kentucky town in the Appalachian foothills.
church_life: Strong Christian heritage and ethos, even though non-denominational. Active chapel and campus ministries.
work_life_balance: Work-college model: every student works 10+ hours/week on campus.
education_quality: Top liberal arts college committed to first-generation and low-income students.
post_school: Pre-nursing or pre-health graduates bridge to graduate nursing entry programs.

name: Goshen College
intl_aid_notes: Goshen advertises a ~$20,000/year International Student Academic Scholarship for admitted international students with strong academics, stackable with need-based aid. The Mennonite ethos of global service is a strong fit for East African Christian applicants.
city_vibe: Small Midwestern college town with a global-service orientation; active study-abroad culture.
church_life: Mennonite roots; broadly welcoming Christian community.
work_life_balance: Tight-knit, service-oriented student body.
education_quality: Long-standing Mennonite liberal-arts reputation; small nursing cohort.
post_school: Indiana and Midwest healthcare systems; Mennonite mission and global-health networks.

name: Cedarville University
intl_aid_notes: Strong BSN reputation with consistent ~95%+ first-time NCLEX pass rates. International merit aid is available but more limited than at John Brown — confirm with admissions.
city_vibe: Small evangelical-college town in central Ohio; conservative campus culture.
church_life: Baptist, evangelical, with required chapel attendance.
work_life_balance: Conservative student-handbook culture; tight-knit.
education_quality: One of the most respected evangelical BSN programs in the US.
post_school: Strong Midwest hospital placement; pipeline to OhioHealth, Kettering Health, and others.

name: Messiah University
intl_aid_notes: Christian college near Harrisburg, PA; merit aid available for strong international applicants. Lettie Pate Whitehead partner school but partner-school citizenship rules typically apply.
city_vibe: Suburban Christian campus near the Pennsylvania state capital.
church_life: Anabaptist-evangelical campus culture; chapel and small groups central.
climate: Four real seasons; mild winters by Pennsylvania standards.
work_life_balance: Tight community; service-oriented student body.
education_quality: Solid regional reputation; CCNE-accredited.
post_school: Harrisburg-area and broader Pennsylvania hospital systems.

name: Alvin Community College (ADN)
bsn_program: 2-year ADN (Associate Degree in Nursing); transfer agreements with Lamar, Texas Tech, U Houston for RN-to-BSN.
intl_aid_notes: Drastically lower sticker cost than a 4-year BSN; out-of-district / out-of-country tuition still under $10K/yr. Path: ADN here, license, then online RN-to-BSN.
city_vibe: Small town south of Houston.
church_life: Conservative Texas Bible-Belt context; many churches nearby.
work_life_balance: Affordable; cheaper cost of living.
education_quality: Reputable ADN program with strong NCLEX outcomes.
post_school: Texas Medical Center (Houston) is the largest medical complex in the world.

name: University of Texas at Arlington
bsn_program: Professional Nursing Pathways Program — 2-year online pathway designed for international students.
intl_aid_notes: UTA specifically markets a 2-year online pathway for international students to prepare for BSN study; affordable and flexible.
city_vibe: Suburban DFW metroplex; very diverse.
church_life: Bible Belt; many large churches in DFW.
work_life_balance: Big-school options at a public-school price.
education_quality: Highly-ranked public nursing program; large online enrollment.
post_school: DFW hospital systems hiring at scale.

name: Austin Community College (ADN entry)
bsn_program: 2-year ADN (entry-level nursing); ACC also runs an RN-to-BSN bridge but RN-to-BSN requires you to already be a licensed RN, so that path is downstream, not an entry point for a high-school graduate.
intl_aid_notes: Austin CC accepts F-1 students for general admission, which is unusual for a community college. CRITICAL CAVEAT: Texas Board of Nursing requires a Social Security Number for RN licensure; F-1 students can only obtain an SSN through on-campus employment, and Texas BON licensure rules for non-immigrant visa holders are restrictive. Confirm directly with the program AND the Texas BON before relying on this path.
city_vibe: Austin is a fast-growing tech and music city; diverse and youthful.
church_life: More secular than the rest of Texas, but a wide range of churches.
work_life_balance: Affordable for Texas; vibrant city scene.
education_quality: Strong community-college nursing reputation.
post_school: Austin and the surrounding Hill Country hospitals.
